actions.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
required_artifacts: a local copy or verified download of the referenced video
required_behaviors: Use evidence-backed inspection of the video contents; do not guess moves.
Preserve the original request even if derived state is incomplete or conflicting.
Write each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt in the exact order shown in the video.
known_invalid_patterns: Assuming file existence or non-empty output is sufficient.
Using partial transcript or partial move list as completion.
verification_plan: Download or otherwise access the referenced video.
Extract the move sequence from the video with evidence.
Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/accessible video.
Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move list from the video.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered move list.
notes: Need to discover available tools and workspace before attempting download/extraction.

actions.command: pwd && ls -la && printf '\n--- tools ---\n' && command -v yt-dlp || true && command -v youtube-dl || true && command -v ffmpeg || true && command -v python3 || true && command -v curl || true && command -v wget || true
